description.value: The study examined changes in food-cue-related brain activation and functional connectivity after laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, and their associations with ghrelin, craving, and BMI.

value: We hypothesized that changes in fasting plasma ghrelin levels post-LSG would be associated with decreased craving for HC food-cues and attenuation of HC food-cue induced activation in brain regions implicated in inhibitory-control.

description.value: Twenty-two obese participants underwent laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy and were scanned before and one month after surgery; nineteen obese controls were scanned at baseline and one month later.
